## berth org

orgs: create, start, stop, connect, move

### Synopsis

orgs: create, start, stop, connect, move.

Each is also a top-level command, as ccenv spelled it:
  berth org ls            = berth ls
  berth org create        = berth init
  berth org info          = berth info
  berth org up            = berth up
  berth org down          = berth down
  berth org restart       = berth restart
  berth org attach        = berth attach
  berth org shell         = berth shell
  berth org logs          = berth logs
  berth org claude        = berth claude
  berth org run           = berth run
  berth org whoami        = berth whoami
  berth org rehydrate     = berth rehydrate
  berth org migrate       = berth migrate
  berth org password      = berth password
  berth org remote        = berth remote
  berth org takeover      = berth takeover
  berth org handback      = berth handback
  berth org connect       = berth connect
  berth org destroy       = berth destroy

Docs: https://ar4mirez.github.io/berth/reference/commands/berth_org/

### Examples

```
  berth org ls
  berth --output json org ls
```

```
  -h, --help   help for org
```
